samples.question: This image shows an arch built from five coloured bands, drawn one inside the other above a grey ground line. The ground line, the small grey ticks below it, the grey page frame and the white background are fixed decoration: they never indicate the answer. All five colours - red, yellow, green, blue and violet - appear exactly once in every image of this set, each as one band, so the set of colours never indicates the answer either. The bands may be stacked in any order, and their thicknesses vary from image to image. The outermost band is the widest arch: the one farthest from the centre of the arch, with white page outside it. Read the stacking order off this image itself, and not from what a rainbow normally looks like. Which colour is the outermost band? Answer with exactly one word: red, yellow, green, blue, or violet.
